analyst_view.overall: Early view: third against fourth, with both sides squeezed between Champions League games: Atlético play at Barcelona on 2 December and at PSV on the 9th, and Betis host Como on the 9th. Atlético had won four straight before losing to Barça and concede little; Pellegrini's Betis won 0-2 at Elche with goals from a set piece and late pressure, and Cucho Hernández should be back from his calf injury by then.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals. Atlético's home games have been tight (1-0 against Deportivo, 1-2 against Barça) and Simeone's side have conceded 10 in 12, while Betis striker Troy Parrott, Pellegrini says, needs confidence. I lean slightly lower, around 2-2.5.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.1 corners. Betis's win at Elche had 17 corners and Pellegrini highlighted set pieces as a growing weapon (Bartra's header from a Ceballos corner), but Atlético's home game with Barça had only 6. I stay around 10.

cards.text: The numbers say 4 cards. Atlético picked up four yellows in their last home game, and Betis had a red and three yellows against Barcelona at home, though none at Elche. A big game between two top-four sides points slightly higher, around 5.

shots.text: The numbers say 29 shots. That is high for Simeone's Atlético, who took 9 against Barça and 11 at Levante, and both teams will have one eye on the Champions League the following week. I lean lower, around 25.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.7 on target. Atlético managed 4 on target against Barcelona and Julián Álvarez's finishing has dipped, though Betis did put 9 on target at Elche. I lean lower, around 8.
